messages.subject: Disconnect message not readable by screen-reader
messages.subject_clean: Disconnect message not readable by screen-reader
messages.body_plain:
Hi folks,

I've been using Shiny to create apps for work for a while, mainly for calculation and visualization. I'm from a math/statistics background rather than CS so Shiny has been extremely useful for me personally. So I'm very grateful for the creators and the community in general!

Recently at work we're trying to fix all of our accessibility issues. And I'm stuck on making the disconnect message readable by a screen-reader (NVDA etc.). I found the css to change the disconnect message (shiny-disconnected-overlay) but have no idea how to add aria-label or other stuff to make it readable.

I have also try packages that change the disconnect message (shinydisconnect, sever etc.) but neither is readable by a screen-reader.

Any help will bee much appreciated!

Best,
Alex
